title: StockBee
tagline: AI-powered stock intelligence designed to help traders spot opportunities the moment they emerge.
disciplines: Product Strategy · Product Design · Brand · Visual Direction

sections.heading: Markets move in seconds. Information doesn't always keep up.
body: StockBee turns market-moving information into real-time intelligence, delivered through WhatsApp and a live command centre built for traders.

sections.heading: Traders don't have time to read reports. They need to know what matters.
body: StockBee turns raw market events into concise signals combining price movement, sentiment, context, and AI-generated summaries.

sections.heading: An alert is only the beginning.
body: Each signal opens into a deeper view of financial performance, market impact, sentiment, source attribution, and AI-generated analysis.
The experience moves from signal → context → understanding, without overwhelming the user along the way.

sections.heading: StockBee isn't only built to help traders react. It's built to help them discover.
body: Trader's Den brings momentum, breakouts, sector movements, derivatives activity, and market signals into one real-time command centre.
The design challenge was to make dense information easy to scan while giving the right signals visual priority.

sections.heading: Financial products demand clarity.
body: Source attribution, sentiment, market impact, and information hierarchy were designed to help traders move quickly without losing context or confidence.
Every element needed to communicate information without creating unnecessary noise or false certainty.

sections.heading: The product extended beyond a single interface.
body: I shaped the visual direction across StockBee's product, WhatsApp experience, marketing surfaces, and brand identity, creating a consistent system that could scale as the product expanded.
The visual language combines a dark, high-contrast environment with vibrant signal colours and restrained typography to create an experience that feels immediate, focused, and distinctive.

sections.heading: Strategy, interaction, visual design, and brand — operating as one system.
body: Starting from an early product idea, I worked across product strategy, experience design, visual direction, and design systems throughout the build.

Working alongside product, engineering, and a five-person design team, I helped shape feature direction, prioritise complexity, establish interaction principles, review and evolve the work, and maintain a consistent product vision through launch.

result.heading: The result
body: StockBee turns fragmented market information into a faster, more connected intelligence experience.
result.statement: Less time finding information. More time understanding what matters.
